chose: the journal stream: +1 file, ~700 lines, 21 exports buys the record its first LIVE reader
over: extending coherence decisions with a --watch flag
extending the panel TUI with a journal view
because: decisions is a settled render (resolution order, open-first) and re-derives everything per read — the wrong shape for a feed; the panel is scoped to claims/status, and grafting a second record type onto its model would couple two instruments that share only a terminal. The stream needs its own seam: a content-addressed tail (journal.ts tailJournal) that survives compaction folds, which neither host has any reason to carry.
